one_line: E-commerce marketing automation platform with a JSON:API REST API for profiles, events, campaigns, flows, and catalogs.
auth_notes: Server-side /api endpoints use private API keys with scopes (header Klaviyo-API-Key); OAuth2 recommended for tech partners; public keys for client-side /client endpoints. Keys generated in account settings.
self_serve_notes: Free tier (up to ~250 contacts) allows generating API keys and calling APIs immediately; paid plans above the cap. No approval.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Profiles, events, metrics, campaigns, flows, messages, segments, lists, tags, catalogs/items, templates, webhooks, tracking; ~60+ JSON:API endpoints
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for events like subscribe/unsubscribe and order events

existing_mcp.note: No official Klaviyo MCP confirmed; community MCP servers exist.

evidence.note: Rich fetched text (7.8KB) covering auth methods, scopes, rate limits, JSON:API features

agent_notes: Private API key path is trivial; OAuth for partner-grade integration.
